Read-only analysis in /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa. Change nothing. Do not commit, push, or modify any file.

GOAL: Understand the current state of the `develop` branch and what the project lead (Tim Lavelle) established through his recent commits. Output feeds a personal engineering playbook — I want durable conventions and architectural decisions, not a changelog.

Do this:

1. Establish the current state: `git log --oneline -40 develop`, `git status`. Identify commits authored by Tim Lavelle (`git log --author` — try variations on the name). Report the range of his recent work and the date span.

2. For each of Tim's commits, report: the commit message, the files touched, and — most importantly — WHAT CONVENTION OR DECISION IT ESTABLISHES that future work must follow. Look past the mechanics to the intent.

3. Pay special attention to and analyse deeply:
   - overrides/app/components/ui-kits/ — the atoms/molecules/organisms structure. What is the naming convention? What must a new component include? Enumerate every component that currently exists there.
   - .claude/rules/ — read every file. Summarise the rules that constrain UI build specifically. Note anything recently changed.
   - overrides/app/theme/ — the foundation vs components split, what's registered in theme/index.ts and what deliberately is NOT (this matters — some scales are unregistered and bare token keys misresolve silently).
   - scripts/generateRegistry.mjs and .claude/registry/ if present — what is the component registry, how is it generated, what is it for.

4. Read overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts in full if it exists. What does it mechanically enforce? This is a real build gate — describe precisely what would fail.

5. Identify the CURRENT canonical example to copy when building a new UI component. Which existing component is the best reference, and why? Give the file paths.

6. Report any place where .docs/ or .claude/rules/ documentation contradicts what the code actually does today.

Report as structured markdown with file:line references. Quote real code. Be explicit about what you could not determine rather than guessing.

########## ad4fbc6 ##########
fix(contentful): render Experience Builder canvas correctly in Contentful Studio

Two independent bugs prevented the /:slug Experience page from ever rendering
inside Contentful Studio's Experience Builder canvas iframe (blank canvas,
empty component picker), despite working fine on the live site:

- useFetchBySlug's canvas-mode detection branches on `typeof window !==
  'undefined'`, which differs between the SSR pass and the client's first
  hydration pass inside an iframe, causing React hydration errors #418/#423
  that discarded the whole render. Defer ExperienceFetch's mount until after
  hydration, scoped only to Contentful's canvas requests (detected via the
  `expEditorMode` query param, visible server-side) so normal storefront SSR
  is unaffected.
- In editor/canvas mode, useFetchBySlug always returns `experience: undefined`
  by SDK design — the real data arrives via postMessage instead. Our own
  `!experience` check was treating that as "page not found" and never letting
  ExperienceRoot mount at all. Now only applies that check outside
  supervised/editor mode.

already is in this app: no Storybook/test setup required, since useUiCopy()
degrades to fallback-only text with no Provider mounted rather than throwing.

consumer. Context sharing removes the redundant-fetch concern that motivated
that pattern in the first place.

########## 5ecd515 ##########
refactor(footer): decompose into atoms/molecules/organisms with co-located styles

What changed:
- Split footer/index.tsx (561 lines, 5 components in one file) into independently
  reusable pieces: ZimmModal (atom), ZimmContactIconRow (molecule),
  ZimmSubscribeSection/ZimmSubscribeModal (organisms), plus footer-local
  BottomBar/FooterNavColumn. footer/index.tsx is now pure assembly (~140 lines).
- Extracted the subscribe state machine into useSubscribeSection, and generalized
  useSubscribeModal -> useZimmModal so its focus/scroll/Tab-trap mechanics aren't
  form-specific. Both now have direct unit tests they lacked as inline logic.
- Co-located each component's theme recipe as <name>.css.ts beside it, replacing
  the single 506-line theme/components/footer.ts (6 recipes + a small
  footerShared.ts for the two values genuinely needed in more than one file).
  No runtime change: Chakra resolves a recipe by name, not file path.
- Fixed two accessibility bugs surfaced by local CodeRabbit review while touching
  this code: the bottom-bar locale control was a focusable, labelled button with
  no action (WCAG 3.2.4/4.1.2 — now a non-interactive div, same treatment as the
  contact-icon fallback); the modal's Tab trap couldn't recover focus once it
  landed outside the dialog (WCAG 2.1.2).
- Updated CODEOWNERS, protectedFiles.md, frozenFiles.md, and overrideStyling.md to
  match: ui-kits/ now has Tier 3 ownership (was previously uncovered by any rule),
  and co-located *.css.ts files route to squad review instead of the Tier 1/2
  UI-designer gate theme/components/ carries — documented as a deliberate,
  narrower exception, not a general loosening. Ran sync:ai-rules to regenerate
  the Cursor/Copilot mirrors of the changed rule docs.

Why: footer review feedback kept landing on "too much logic in one file, doesn't
follow our atom/molecule/organism structure." This establishes that pattern —
co-located styles, organism-level reuse — as the example other component
overrides should follow.

- Replaced 24 bare spacing-scale keys (gap/padding*/margin*, e.g. 'xs', '2xs',

  etc.) with their var(--zimm-*) equivalents, across 9 files. Both forms

  the Zimmermann foundations — see theme/index.ts) — this is a house-style
  change, not a bug fix. Two of the instances were in JSX (footerNavColumn's
  sx merge), not just recipe files.
- Caught mid-fix: zimmTextInput.css.ts's `top: floated ? '3xs' : '50%'` had a
  bare key hiding inside a conditional branch. Fixed, and fixed the guard that
  should have caught it (see below) — the component's own test asserted the
  old bare value and needed updating too.
- Extended theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts with a new guard: no
  override-component style may use a bare token key on a registered scale.
  Runs on every `npm run test`, so this becomes a mechanical PR check rather
  than something a reviewer re-verifies by eye each time.
- That new guard initially had the same blind spot as the bug it was built to
  catch: it resolved a function-form baseStyle (zimmTextInput's) with a single
  fixed all-false props object, so a value that only appears down a
  conditional branch — like the '3xs' above — was never walked. Fixed by
  resolving across all 2^n combinations of the function's boolean props
  instead of one. Verified this actually works by reintroducing the bare
  '3xs' and confirming the guard fails on it, then restoring the fix.
- Fixed one real bug a local CodeRabbit review surfaced while in this code:
  ZimmSubscribeSection rendered its unavailable/error failure copy with the
  same `success` style as the success message — a shopper saw failure text
  styled as a confirmation. Added a dedicated `error` part (inverse-mode
  error colour, matching the pattern zimmTextInput.css.ts's error state
  already uses) and role="alert" on the failure message.
- Updated overrideStyling.md (hierarchy point 2) and css.md (token example)
  to document var(--zimm-*) as required, not just preferred, and to point at
  the new mechanical guard.

Why: bare Chakra token keys and var(--zimm-*) both resolve correctly today,
but a bare key forces a PR reviewer to check theme/index.ts's registered-scale
list to know whether it's actually correct — a raw zimm var is unambiguous at
every call site regardless.

What changed:
- Replaced 24 bare spacing-scale keys (gap/padding*/margin*, e.g. 'xs', '2xs',
  '3xl') and 5 bare semantic colour tokens ('background.05', 'text.inverse',
  etc.) with their var(--zimm-*) equivalents, across 9 files. Both forms
  resolve to the identical value (theme.space/theme.colors ARE registered from
  the Zimmermann foundations — see theme/index.ts) — this is a house-style
  change, not a bug fix. Two of the instances were in JSX (footerNavColumn's
  sx merge), not just recipe files.
- Caught mid-fix: zimmTextInput.css.ts's `top: floated ? '3xs' : '50%'` had a
  bare key hiding inside a conditional branch. Fixed, and fixed the guard that
  should have caught it (see below) — the component's own test asserted the
  old bare value and needed updating too.
- Extended theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts with a new guard: no
  override-component style may use a bare token key on a registered scale.
  Runs on every `npm run test`, so this becomes a mechanical PR check rather
  than something a reviewer re-verifies by eye each time.
- That new guard initially had the same blind spot as the bug it was built to
  catch: it resolved a function-form baseStyle (zimmTextInput's) with a single
  fixed all-false props object, so a value that only appears down a
  conditional branch — like the '3xs' above — was never walked. Fixed by
  resolving across all 2^n combinations of the function's boolean props
  instead of one. Verified this actually works by reintroducing the bare
  '3xs' and confirming the guard fails on it, then restoring the fix.
- Fixed one real bug a local CodeRabbit review surfaced while in this code:
  ZimmSubscribeSection rendered its unavailable/error failure copy with the
  same `success` style as the success message — a shopper saw failure text
  styled as a confirmation. Added a dedicated `error` part (inverse-mode
  error colour, matching the pattern zimmTextInput.css.ts's error state
  already uses) and role="alert" on the failure message.
- Updated overrideStyling.md (hierarchy point 2) and css.md (token example)
  to document var(--zimm-*) as required, not just preferred, and to point at
  the new mechanical guard.

Why: bare Chakra token keys and var(--zimm-*) both resolve correctly today,
but a bare key forces a PR reviewer to check theme/index.ts's registered-scale
list to know whether it's actually correct — a raw zimm var is unambiguous at
every call site regardless.

1	/**
     2	 * Zimmermann custom Chakra UI theme.
     3	 *
     4	 * This file composes the theme from `foundation/` (brand tokens) and
     5	 * `components/` (per-component overrides). Add a new component override by
     6	 * creating a file in `components/` and registering it in `components/index.ts`.
     7	 *
     8	 * Usage:
     9	 *   import theme from 'overrides/app/theme'
    10	 *   <ChakraProvider theme={theme}>…</ChakraProvider>
    11	 *
    12	 * Extend via extendTheme() — see Chakra UI docs:
    13	 * https://chakra-ui.com/docs/styled-system/customize-theme
    14	 */
    15	import baseTheme from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/theme';
    16	import { extendTheme, type ThemeOverride } from '@chakra-ui/react';
    17	import { borderWidths, breakpoints, colors, fonts, spacing, textStyles } from './foundation';
    18	import { components } from './components';
    19	import { globalStyles } from './globalStyles';
    20	
    21	// Note: --zimm-* CSS custom properties are injected onto :root via a raw
    22	// <Global> in _app-config/index.tsx (ZimmTokensGlobal). They cannot go through
    23	// Chakra's styles.global because Chakra's style processor strips quotes from
    24	// font-family values like "'Futura Round', sans-serif", outputting just "sans-serif".
    25	//
    26	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    27	// Which foundations are registered as Chakra scales, and which are not
    28	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    29	// Registered below: borderWidths, breakpoints, colors, fonts, space, textStyles.
    30	//
    31	// Deliberately NOT registered, because the Zimmermann scale and the Chakra scale
    32	// use the same key names for different values — remapping them would silently
    33	// restyle the base retail-react-app, which uses those names at ~199 call sites:
    34	//
    35	//   fontSizes    Chakra md=16px xs=12px 2xs=10px 3xs=7.2px
    36	//                Zimmermann md=24px xs=16px 2xs=14px 3xs=12px  (4 collisions)
    37	//   transition   Chakra duration.fast=150ms slow=300ms
    38	//                Zimmermann fast=200ms default=300ms slow=500ms
    39	//   sizes        Chakra sizes.lg=32rem vs iconSizes.lg=20px
    40	//
    41	// Set type with `textStyle` (all 22 Handover text styles are registered), never a
    42	// raw `fontSize` token. For motion, icon and action dimensions, import the
    43	// constants from `foundation/` directly — the pattern component overrides already
    44	// use for FONT_MEDIUM. `theme/index.test.tsx` guards these scales against being
    45	// remapped by a future change.
    46	//
    47	// The 15 numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases are duplicates of the named scale
    48	// (400 = 16px = `m`) and exist only for the .zimm-* global classes; the named
    49	// scale is the Chakra-facing surface.
    50	
    51	const overrides: ThemeOverride = {
    52	  borderWidths,
    53	  breakpoints,
    54	  colors,
    55	  fonts,
    56	  space: spacing,
    57	  textStyles,
    58	  components,
    59	  styles: {
    60	    global: globalStyles,
    61	  },
    62	};
    63	
    64	const theme = extendTheme(baseTheme, overrides);
    65	
    66	export default theme;

fix(contentful): render Experience Builder canvas correctly in Contentful Studio

Two independent bugs prevented the /:slug Experience page from ever rendering
inside Contentful Studio's Experience Builder canvas iframe (blank canvas,
empty component picker), despite working fine on the live site:

- useFetchBySlug's canvas-mode detection branches on `typeof window !==
  'undefined'`, which differs between the SSR pass and the client's first
  hydration pass inside an iframe, causing React hydration errors #418/#423
  that discarded the whole render. Defer ExperienceFetch's mount until after
  hydration, scoped only to Contentful's canvas requests (detected via the
  `expEditorMode` query param, visible server-side) so normal storefront SSR
  is unaffected.
- In editor/canvas mode, useFetchBySlug always returns `experience: undefined`
  by SDK design — the real data arrives via postMessage instead. Our own
  `!experience` check was treating that as "page not found" and never letting
  ExperienceRoot mount at all. Now only applies that check outside
  supervised/editor mode.

# This project uses Vitest (see package.json "test": "vitest run").
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  unit-tests:
    name: Unit tests (Vitest)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.vitest == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --include=dev

      - name: Run Vitest unit tests
        run: npm test
        env:
          CI: true

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Storybook interaction + a11y tests — runs on every PR to develop
  # and release/**. Exercises play() functions and @storybook/addon-a11y
  # component-level checks headless. Runs in parallel with unit-tests.
  # Runner: @storybook/test-runner (Playwright-based). Storybook is built
  # to storybook-static/, served by http-server, tested by test-storybook.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
=== pre-commit hook ===
     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# Pre-commit hook:
     3	#   1. Regenerate the Claude Code registry and stage any changes.
     4	#   2. If any Studio Experiences component (experiences/*.tsx) is staged,
     5	#      regenerate definitions.ts and stage it automatically.
     6	#   3. Protect derived configuration files from direct edits.
     7	#   4. Block .env.sample commits that contain secret-class key values.
     8	#
     9	# Setup: hooks are managed by Husky v9 — run `npm install` and they are installed automatically.
    10	#   Husky sets core.hooksPath to .husky/_ and .husky/pre-commit calls this script.
    11	#   If you ever need to install manually (e.g. npm install --ignore-scripts):
    12	#   cp scripts/hooks/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
    13	#   cp scripts/hooks/commit-msg .git/hooks/commit-msg && chmod +x .git/hooks/commit-msg
    14	
    15	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16	# 0. Ensure node is on PATH.
    17	#    Git hooks run in a non-interactive shell — version managers (nvm, fnm,
    18	#    volta) are not sourced automatically. Try each in turn; fail loudly if
    19	#    node still can't be found so the developer knows what to fix.
    20	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    21	
    22	if ! command -v node &>/dev/null; then
    23	  # nvm (most common on macOS)
    24	  export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
    25	  [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
    26	
    27	  # fnm
    28	  if ! command -v node &>/dev/null && command -v fnm &>/dev/null; then
    29	    eval "$(fnm env 2>/dev/null || true)"
    30	  fi
    31	
    32	  # volta
    33	  if ! command -v node &>/dev/null; then
    34	    export PATH="$HOME/.volta/bin:$PATH"
    35	  fi
    36	
    37	  if ! command -v node &>/dev/null; then
    38	    echo "  ❌  pre-commit: node not found. Make sure your version manager is"
    39	    echo "      initialised (nvm, fnm, or volta) and node is installed."
    40	    exit 1
    41	  fi
    42	fi
    43	
    44	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    45	# 1. Registry regeneration — runs on every commit to keep .claude/registry/
    46	#    in sync. Stages any updated registry files automatically.
    47	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    48	
    49	staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only)
    50	
    51	registry_components=$(echo "$staged" | grep -E '^overrides/app/components/' || true)
    52	registry_hooks=$(echo "$staged" | grep -E '^overrides/app/hooks/' || true)
    53	registry_utils=$(echo "$staged" | grep -E '^overrides/app/utils/' || true)
    54	registry_pages=$(echo "$staged" | grep -E '^overrides/app/pages/' || true)
    55	registry_routes=$(echo "$staged" | grep -E '^overrides/app/routes\.(tsx|jsx)$' || true)
    56	
    57	if [ -n "$registry_components$registry_hooks$registry_utils$registry_pages$registry_routes" ] \
    58	  && command -v node &>/dev/null && [ -f "scripts/generateRegistry.mjs" ]; then
    59	  echo "Regenerating Claude Code registry..."
    60	  node scripts/generateRegistry.mjs
    61	  git add .claude/registry/
    62	fi
    63	
    64	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    65	# 1b. AI rules sync — when a .claude/ source file is staged, auto-regenerate
    66	#     the derived files (.cursor/rules/, .vscode/instructions/,
    67	#     .github/copilot-instructions.md) and stage the updates. Only the "auto"
    68	#     targets are regenerated; manual targets remain untouched.
    69	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    70	
    71	if command -v node &>/dev/null && [ -f "scripts/syncCursorRules.mjs" ]; then
    72	  ai_sources_staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only \
    73	    | grep -E '^\.claude/(rules/.*\.md|skills/.*/SKILL\.md)$' \
    74	    || true)
    75	
    76	  if [ -n "$ai_sources_staged" ]; then
    77	    echo "AI rule source(s) changed — running sync:ai-rules:fix..."
    78	    if ! node scripts/syncCursorRules.mjs --fix > /dev/null; then
    79	      echo ""
    80	      echo "  ❌  sync:ai-rules:fix failed — derived AI config files may be stale or partially"

---
name: new-component
description: Scaffold a new Zimmermann component under overrides/app/components/ — TypeScript, Chakra-first, with a paired Storybook story. Use whenever a new custom component is needed.
---

Scaffold a new Zimmermann custom component.

The component name is: $ARGUMENTS

## Conventions

Follow [.claude/rules/conventions.md](../../rules/conventions.md) (naming, folder layout,
cross-cutting rules), [components.md](../../rules/components.md) (props types, JSDoc policy,
composition, Storybook categorisation), and [css.md](../../rules/css.md) (Chakra token usage)
— together the single source of truth for scaffolding. Higher-level project rules live in
[AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md). Do not restate rules here — read those files before
scaffolding.

Key implications for scaffolding:
- Component lives in its own folder: `componentName/index.tsx` (Zimmermann-authored) or
  `component-name/index.tsx` (override of a base SF component).
- Props type named `<ComponentName>Props`, declared at the top of `index.tsx` by default.
- Storybook story is mandatory; Vitest only when the component owns non-trivial logic.

## Steps

1. Read one nearby existing custom component under [overrides/app/components/](../../../overrides/app/components/) to match code style, import order, and Chakra usage. If no Zimmermann-authored component exists yet, read a base template component from `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/` and convert the style to TypeScript + Chakra props.

2. Create `overrides/app/components/<componentName>/index.tsx`:
   - Functional React component, named export (`export function <ComponentName>`) plus default export.
   - `type <ComponentName>Props = { ... }` at the top of the file.
   - JSDoc above the component if it will be consumed by ≥2 callers (shared/Tier 2).
   - Chakra primitives for layout (`Box`, `Flex`, `Text`, etc.) using theme tokens — no hardcoded hex, pixel spacing, or raw font sizes.
   - No data-fetching hooks of any kind (commerce SDK hooks like `useCurrentBasket`/`useCurrentCustomer`/`useProduct`, or React Query) — accept data as props; the parent (a page or container component) owns data fetching. See components.md → Composition → Container/presentational separation. content.content:
- Contentful Studio integration (pointing to mock account)
- **Contentful content model tooling** (`npm run sync:contentful` / `npm run install:contentful`) — authors `scripts/contentful/content-types/` as one organization-scoped Environment Template and installs it per environment via the Management API (replaced the earlier per-environment sync.js + migrations pipeline, 2026-08-23).
- **ShoppableImage component decommissioned** (2026-08-23) — it was a Studio Experience component + standard content type synced 2026-05-11, but had 0 entries and was removed (content type, React component, and its hotspotMarker/hotspotPopup sub-components) once the region/link/footerConfig content model landed. `CollectionHero` and `ImageText` are the remaining Studio Experience components.
- Basic SFCC Commerce SDK integration (pointing to mock account)
- Home page / home-preview page merged
- Functional requirements signed off (Checkout, Returns, Orders, Payments, Cart, Regional, Content, PDP/PLP, Search, CRM)
- Design token foundation ported from the F2R Handover into `overrides/app/theme/foundation/` (`colour.ts`, `typography.ts`, `gridSystem.ts`, `spacing.ts`, `sizes.ts`, `motion.ts`, `zimmTokens.ts`) plus the `.zimm-*` global classes in `overrides/app/theme/globalStyles.ts`; composed in `overrides/app/theme/index.ts`, per-component overrides now co-located beside their component as `<name>.css.ts` and registered in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (`theme/components/` itself now holds only `header.ts`/`listMenu.ts` as registered recipes, plus `navConstants.ts` and `footerShared.ts` for values shared across split-out files). Delivered as a foundation for the manual UI build (branch `feature/design-tokens-implementation-to-dev`); F2R component work continues separately on `feature/f2r-component-registry` and `feature/f2r-implementation-workflow`. Futura Round **is** self-hosted as of SFCC-55 — two faces (400/500) ship from `overrides/app/static/fonts/` and are served on every tier. Open with the UI designer: primary-action hover contrast (2.96:1), inverse focus ring, and button-height / nav letter-spacing deviations from the Handover.
- **Token architecture hardened** (2026-08-18): `zimmTokens.ts` (the `--zimm-*` CSS-var registry) is now fully derived from the other `foundation/*` files via imports instead of hand-duplicated literals, closing the drift risk the original port above carried. `typography.ts` gained a proper `fontSizes`/`lineHeights`/`letterSpacings`/`fontWeights` scale layer. `spacing.ts`/`typography.ts` converted px → rem (WCAG 1.4.4); within those two files, px is kept only for hairline geometry (border widths, focus-ring offsets — now named tokens in `spacing.ts`'s `focusRingOffsets`). `zimmButton.css.ts`'s provisional height/padding constants are a separate, already-flagged px exception (not hairline geometry) — see below. `zimmButton.css.ts` is now the single source of truth for button styling — `globalStyles.ts`'s conflicting `.zimm-btn-*`/`.zimm-text-btn-*` classes (different heights, transparent-vs-opaque secondary background, zero interactive states) were removed entirely; any button must use Chakra's `<Button>`, never a class. `header.ts`/`listMenu.ts` brought onto the same `var(--zimm-*)` convention (no direct `foundation/` imports, no Chakra semantic colour-token names). New `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` documents the styling-source hierarchy, unit rules, the alias-is-a-reference-not-a-copy principle, and a real gotcha: importing an already-overridden component via the SFCC base path resolves correctly in the real app but silently renders the unstyled base version in Storybook/Vitest (the `ccExtensibility` resolver is webpack-only, neither tool loads it). Still open, flagged inline rather than silently resolved: `zimmButton.css.ts`'s `BTN_HEIGHT_LG`/`BTN_HEIGHT_SM` (50px/41px prototype values) disagree with the Handover-sourced `actionSizes.height.lg`/`.md` (52px/40px); `BTN_PADDING_Y` (5px) has no Handover token at all — both pending UI-designer sign-off.
- **Header override** (`overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx`): two-row layout, brand logo via `BrandLogo` component (overrides base SVG at `overrides/app/assets/svg/brand-logo.svg`), uppercase nav with `::after` hover animation, Account/Saved/Bag text buttons with matching animation, chevrons hidden. Still being refined visually against Figma.
- Path aliases (`~` → root, `app` → `overrides/app`) wired up across Babel, tsconfig, Storybook, and Jest
- **Per-tier environment switching** (`npm run env` → `scripts/switchEnv.mjs`) — manages `.env.shared` / `.env.<tier>` across dev/test/sit/uat/staging/prod via `init` (scaffold + pull + Contentful auto-fetch), `validate [--live]` (structural checks plus live Contentful Delivery API + SFCC SLAS guest-token calls), and `push <scope>` (tier-1-approvers only). Shared/tier values (excluding personal credentials) can be centrally published through this repo's GitHub Environments (`shared` + one per tier) — write gated to repo Admin. Landed 2026-07-13.

## In Progress
- **SFCC-55 global footer** (PR #59): footer decomposed into `overrides/app/components/footer/` plus
  `ui-kits/{atoms,molecules,organisms}/`, most with a co-located `<name>.css.ts` recipe registered in
  `theme/components/index.ts`. `FooterContainer` fetches live Contentful `footerConfig` client-side and
  resolves per-storefront content via `utils/resolveByRegion.ts`. Microcopy comes from the `uiCopy` content
  type through `useUiCopy` (Context provider mounted in `_app-config`). Open items: the footer is not in the
  SSR HTML (client-only `useEffect` fetch, no `getProps`); no locale is passed to Contentful, so all
  storefronts currently receive the space default; and `en-CA` — which `SITE_LOCALES` lists for
  ZimmermannUSIntl — is now in `bootstrapSpace.mjs`'s locale list, but whether the **live** space has it
  is still unconfirmed from the repo. Re-running `setup:contentful` is what would provision it; until
  someone does, `/en-ca/` Experience pages still send an unknown locale to the CDA.
- **Header visual refinement**: layout and animations are implemented; still being iterated against the draft Figma to close remaining gaps

## What's Pending
- All integrations need to point to production accounts (SFCC, Contentful)
- Global-e integration (confirm pricing flow mechanism before implementing)
- Didomi consent management (implement per storefront defaults in REG-054)
- Omneo / Emarsys marketing sync
- Adyen payment integration
- MuleSoft middleware connections
- PDP, PLP, Cart, Checkout flows
- BOPIS (Collect in Boutique) checkout flow
- Full multi-site routing — 8 SFCC sites across 6 regions (AU, US domestic, US international, UK, EU domestic, EU international, HK, ME). **US site topology updated (REG-005, 2026-07-10):** US splits into two separate SFCC sites — US domestic (`/us/`, SFCC checkout) and US international (`/en-ca/`, Global-e checkout). New site ID `ZimmermannUSIntl` pending BM confirmation.
- Address autocomplete via Google Maps API

content.content:
2-
3:_Key technical decisions, stack overview, overrides pattern, component organisation, and key paths. Update this file when the stack changes, a new integration is added, or a structural decision is made._
4-
5-Production storefront for www.zimmermann.com — multi-locale, multi-currency, eight storefronts across six regions (AU, US, UK, EU, HK, ME), with both EU and US each split into two storefronts (domestic + international).
6-
--
129-- **Overriding a base template component:** copy from `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/` to the mirrored path in `overrides/` (see Overrides Pattern above).
130:- **Brand-new components** (no base template equivalent): create them in `overrides/app/components/custom/`.
131-
132-## Key Paths
133-
--
135-- **Contentful config:** `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts` — always render locale-specific content using Contentful's native localisation fields. Gate preview/draft content behind a server-side check; never expose draft content in production.
136:- **Theme / design tokens:** `overrides/app/theme/` — `index.ts` composes the theme; brand tokens live in `foundation/` (colour, fonts, typography, gridSystem, spacing, sizes, motion, and the `--zimm-*` registry in `zimmTokens.ts` — Tier 1, UI Designer owned); the `.zimm-*` global classes composed from them live in `globalStyles.ts` (Tier 2); a per-component override lives either one file each in `components/` (e.g. `header.ts`, `listMenu.ts` — Tier 2, UI-designer gated) **or**, per the co-location pattern, beside its component as `<name>.css.ts` (e.g. `overrides/app/components/footer/footer.css.ts`, `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton/zimmButton.css.ts` — governed by that component's own CODEOWNERS entry instead). Either way it's registered in `theme/components/index.ts`. See [.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md](../.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md) > Co-locating a component's theme file. Note: brand fonts (Futura Round) **are** self-hosted — two faces ship from `overrides/app/static/fonts/` via `theme/fontFace.tsx`, mounted unconditionally, so they are served on every tier. See [.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md](../.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md) > Design System.
137:- **App shell (Header/Footer):** `overrides/app/components/_app/index.tsx`
138:- **Header:** `overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx`
139:- **Custom components:** `overrides/app/components/custom/`
140-- **Assets:** `overrides/app/static/`, `overrides/app/assets/svg/`
141-
142-## Design Source of Truth
--
149-
150:Two rows: top bar (nav + icons) and logo row. Implemented in `overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx`, with Chakra theme overrides split across `overrides/app/theme/components/header.ts` and `overrides/app/theme/components/listMenu.ts`.
151-
152-**Logo**: uses `BrandLogo` from the icons package (PWA default with the svg file replaced). The Z.IMMERSE variant has not been implemented yet.
153-
--
192-**Relationship to the React component:**
193:Each content type definition in `scripts/contentful/content-types/` corresponds to a React component in `overrides/app/components/contentful/`. The content type's field IDs must match the TypeScript type in `overrides/app/types/contentful.ts`.
194-
195:**Experience Builder components** (drag-and-drop in Contentful Studio) are a separate concern — they are registered in `overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/definitions.ts` and do not need a corresponding content-type entry unless they also have a standard content type for use outside Studio.
196-
197-## Path Aliases
198-

I have everything I need from my own investigation. Writing up now.

# Zimmermann PWA — `develop` state and Tim Lavelle's established conventions

## 1. Current state

**Branch:** `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-info` (not `develop`). 29 staged files — a PDP static-info build adding 6 `ui-kits` components, `pages/product-detail/`, `utils/richText.tsx`.

**`develop` HEAD:** `8362b3c` — *Merge pull request #59 from ZimmermannAU/feature/SFCC-55_global-footer-ui*, merged 2026-08-24. That merge brought **93 commits**: 54 Marcel Angelo Navarro, 25 Jersey Perez, **14 TimLavelle**.

**Tim Lavelle has two git identities:**
- `TimLavelle <tim+1@lavelle.bio>` — 76 commits, all authored work
- `TimLavelleACC <timothy.lavelle@accenture.com>` — 62 commits, almost entirely PR merges

**138 commits total, spanning 2026-07-03 → 2026-08-24.** His recent decisive burst is **14 commits over two days, 2026-08-23 → 2026-08-24** (`5ecd515` … `7b9b5dc`). Everything architecturally load-bearing about how UI is now built in this repo comes from that window.

---

## 2. Tim's 14 recent commits — the decision behind each

| # | Commit | Date | Convention it establishes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `5ecd515` `refactor(footer): decompose into atoms/molecules/organisms with co-located styles` | 08-23 | **The founding commit.** Component decomposition into `ui-kits/{atoms,molecules,organisms}/`, recipe co-located as `<name>.css.ts`, container reduced to pure assembly. |
| 2 | `a063e14` `refactor(ui-kits): co-locate zimmButton/zimmNavItem/zimmTextInput theme recipes` | 08-23 | Co-location is the **default**, not the footer's special case. Retro-applied to all pre-existing atoms. |
| 3 | `9d5f89c` `refactor(theme): require var(--zimm-*) over bare Chakra token keys in overrides` | 08-23 | `var(--zimm-*)` is **required, not preferred** — and backed by a new mechanical guard. |
| 4 | `5b2be3f` `feat(contentful): add region-aware footer/link content model…` | 08-23 | Content model authored once as an org-level Environment Template; `region`/`link` as reusable referenceable primitives. |
| 5 | `98bd633` `chore: sync package-lock.json` | 08-23 | (mechanical) |
| 6 | `466e62b` `feat(theme): build scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs, close the missing-audit gap` | 08-23 | A documented tool that doesn't exist is a **defect**. Also: the acknowledged-exception vocabulary. |
| 7 | `ad4fbc6` `fix(contentful): render Experience Builder canvas correctly` | 08-23 | SSR/hydration parity for editor-mode branches. |
| 8 | `5640c25` `feat(footer): wire footer container to live Contentful footerConfig` | 08-23 | **Structural content fails closed** — render nothing on load/error/no-match, never placeholder. |
| 9 | `c5a8422` `test(footer): add Vitest coverage for FooterContainer, FooterNavColumn, ZimmSubscribeSection` | 08-23 | Each suite scoped to *its own component's contract*; mock what's proven elsewhere. |
| 10 | `0b8db3e` `feat(footer): wire footer microcopy to Contentful uiCopy via useUiCopy` | 08-23 | **Microcopy fails open** — a CMS outage must never blank a control. Bulk-fetch: N entries = 1 call. |
| 11 | `c735478` `feat(contentful): add editor-facing title field to uiCopy` | 08-23 | Every content type gets a human-scannable `displayField` separate from its code lookup key. |
| 12 | `90069b2` `refactor(footer): make useUiCopy a true app-wide utility via Context` | 08-24 | **Context over prop-drilling** for app-wide static content; degrade to fallback, never throw. |
| 13 | `542ac65` `docs(rules): align governance docs with this branch's footer/uiCopy patterns` | 08-24 | Governance docs are updated **in the same branch** that changes the pattern. |
| 14 | `7b9b5dc` `fix(storybook): define WEBPACK_TARGET so ssr-config resolves the browser-safe branch` | 08-24 | Storybook must resolve the same browser branch the real build does. |

### The durable decisions, stated plainly

**D1 — Decomposition is the unit of review.** From `5ecd515`'s body:

> Why: footer review feedback kept landing on "too much logic in one file, doesn't follow our atom/molecule/organism structure." This establishes that pattern — co-located styles, organism-level reuse — as the example other component overrides should follow.

`footer/index.tsx` went 561 lines → ~140 lines of pure assembly. Extract the state machine to a hook; extract reusable pieces to `ui-kits/`; leave the container assembling.

**D2 — A component's recipe lives beside it, and governance follows the file.** Co-location is *purely organisational at runtime* — Chakra resolves by string key, not path (`a063e14`: "this is a pure file move"). But it deliberately **changes the approval gate**: `CODEOWNERS:186`

```
overrides/app/components/**/*.css.ts    @ZimmermannAU/pwa-squad-a @ZimmermannAU/pwa-squad-b
```

with the comment at `CODEOWNERS:181-183` explaining the mechanism — *"CODEOWNERS uses last-match-wins, not most-specific-wins — so this overrides the heavier Tier 2 directory rules above."* Component logic in `header/`/`footer/` stays Tier 2; only style files drop to squad review.

**D3 — Every value in a `.css.ts` is a `var(--zimm-*)` reference or a named, justified constant.** Never a bare Chakra key, never a raw literal. See §4.

**D4 — Two opposite failure policies, chosen deliberately.**
- *Structural content* (`footerConfig`) → **fail closed.** `5640c25`: "Renders nothing on load/error/no-match rather than falling back to placeholder content."
- *Microcopy* (`uiCopy`) → **fail open.** `uiCopyProvider/index.tsx:29-32`: "losing a button label or a status message to a Contentful outage should never blank a control."

**D5 — App-wide static content goes through Context, not props.** `90069b2` explicitly *reverted* the prop-drilling approach `0b8db3e` had shipped one commit earlier:

> This replaces the footer-only container-fetch-and-prop-drill pattern from the previous commit, which only worked because FooterContainer was the sole consumer.

`useUiCopy.ts:38` is the whole hook:
```ts
export const useUiCopy = (): UiCopyContextValue => useContext(UiCopyContext) ?? FALLBACK_ONLY;
```
The `?? FALLBACK_ONLY` is load-bearing — it's why a leaf can call it with zero Storybook/test setup. This is the **documented exception** to container/presentational separation (`components.md`), and it explicitly does *not* extend to `useIntl`, which throws without its Provider.

**D6 — Prove a guard fails before trusting it.** `9d5f89c`'s body, on the guard it had just written:

> That new guard initially had the same blind spot as the bug it was built to catch… Fixed by resolving across all 2^n combinations… **Verified this actually works by reintroducing the bare '3xs' and confirming the guard fails on it, then restoring the fix.**

---

## 3. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/`

### Naming convention

| Element | Rule | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Tier folder | `atoms` / `molecules` / `organisms` | `ui-kits/molecules/` |
| Component folder | `camelCase`, **`zimm` prefix mandatory** | `zimmContactIconRow/` |
| Component file | always `index.tsx` | `zimmContactIconRow/index.tsx` |
| Export | **named only, `PascalCase`, matches folder. Zero default exports.** | `export const ZimmContactIconRow` |
| Props type | `<ComponentName>Props`, top of `index.tsx` | `type ZimmContactIconRowProps = {…}` |
| Recipe file | `<folderName>.css.ts` beside `index.tsx` | `zimmContactIconRow.css.ts` |
| Recipe export | `PascalCase`, **`Zimm`-namespaced** (never a bare SFCC name) | `export const ZimmContactIconRow = {…}` |
| Story | `index.stories.tsx` | mandatory, 16/16 |
| Test | `index.test.tsx` | only when there's real branching |

I verified the export rule mechanically — `grep -rn "export default" overrides/app/components/ui-kits/ --include=index.tsx` returns **nothing**. All 16 use `export const`.

### Complete inventory

**On `develop` — 10 components:**

*Atoms (6)* — `zimmButton`, `zimmIcon`, `zimmLogo`, `zimmModal`, `zimmNavItem`, `zimmTextInput`
*Molecules (2)* — `zimmContactIconRow`, `zimmInputAction`
*Organisms (2)* — `zimmSubscribeModal`, `zimmSubscribeSection`

**Working tree adds 6** (staged, SFCC-89, not yet on develop): atoms `zimmProductDescription`, `zimmProductModelInfo`, `zimmProductName`, `zimmProductPrice`, `zimmProductStyleCode`; molecule `zimmProductContent`. **Total 16.**

### What a new component must include

- **Always:** `index.tsx` + `index.stories.tsx`. Story coverage is 16/16 — no exceptions in practice.
- **A `<name>.css.ts` recipe when it has any styling of its own.** 11 of 16 have one. The 5 without (`zimmIcon`, `zimmLogo`, `zimmInputAction`, `zimmProductName`, `zimmProductModelInfo`) style entirely through inline Chakra props — `a063e14` calls this out explicitly: *"none of the three have a separate theme file to begin with… the co-location pattern has nothing to move for them."*
- **Registration in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` if it has a recipe** — import + add to the `components` object. Forgetting this is silent: `useMultiStyleConfig('X')` returns `{}`, `__css={undefined}` is legal, the element renders unstyled.
- **`index.test.tsx` only when the component owns branching/decision logic.** 4 of 16 have one on develop (just `zimmSubscribeSection`).

### Two conventions that are real but **undocumented**

**(a) The recipe key as a named constant.** Every component Tim wrote does this:
```ts
// zimmContactIconRow/index.tsx:6
const ZIMM_CONTACT_ICON_ROW_RECIPE = 'ZimmContactIconRow';
…
const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_CONTACT_ICON_ROW_RECIPE, {});
```
Applied in `footer/index.tsx:15`, `footerNavColumn/index.tsx:7`, `bottomBar/index.tsx:7`, `zimmModal/index.tsx:5`, `zimmSubscribeSection/index.tsx:8`, `zimmSubscribeModal/index.tsx:9-10`. **It has already eroded** — `zimmNavItem/index.tsx:33`, `zimmTextInput/index.tsx:80` and all 6 staged product components pass the string inline. Written down nowhere, so it will keep eroding.

**(b) Folder tier ≠ Storybook category.** The atomic tier does *not* appear in `title`. Categories come from `components.md`'s semantic list:
```
atoms/zimmButton         → 'Elements/ZimmButton'
molecules/zimmInputAction → 'Forms/ZimmInputAction'
organisms/zimmSubscribeSection → 'Forms/ZimmSubscribeSection'
atoms/zimmProductPrice   → 'Commerce/ZimmProductPrice'
```

### The gap I could not close

**There is no documented criterion anywhere for what makes something an atom vs a molecule vs an organism.** I grepped `.docs/`, `.claude/rules/`, and `AGENTS.md`. The only mentions are incidental path references. `.claude/rules/components.md` and `conventions.md` still describe only the flat `overrides/app/components/productTile/` layout. `.claude/skills/new-component/SKILL.md` — the scaffolding skill — never mentions `ui-kits/` at all. Classification is inferred from the 16 existing examples and nothing else.

---

## 4. `.claude/rules/` — what constrains a UI build

12 files. Six were rewritten during Tim's window (mtime 2026-08-24): `components.md`, `css.md`, `frozenFiles.md`, `overrideStyling.md`, `protectedFiles.md`, `testing.md`. Untouched since July: `conventions.md`, `typescript.md`, `squadA.md`, `squadB.md`.

### The styling hierarchy (`overrideStyling.md`), in order

1. **`textStyle` for all type.** `textStyle="body2"`, never a raw `fontSize`. This is the one entry allowed to stay a bare key — there's no `var()` for a composite expansion.
2. **`var(--zimm-*)` for colour and spacing.** Required, not preferred, since `9d5f89c`. Rationale (`recipeGuards.test.ts:31-34`): not correctness — a bare key resolves fine — but so *"a PR reviewer sees an unambiguous zimm reference at every call site instead of having to recall which scales are and are not registered."*
3. **The component's own `<name>.css.ts`** for variant/size/state.
4. **`sx`** for a one-off prop-system gap.
5. **Scoped `.scss`** only when `sx` genuinely can't express it.

**Never:** a raw hex/px/rem/em in a component file.

### Units
- `rem` — anything scaling with root font-size (WCAG 1.4.4): type, spacing.
- `px` — hairline geometry only: border widths, focus-ring offsets.
- `em` — breakpoints only.

### Responsive steps are explicit media queries, not Chakra arrays

```ts
[`@media (min-width: ${BP.tablet})`]: { gap: 'var(--zimm-scale-3xl)' },
```

`overrideStyling.md` is explicit that the array shorthand (`['2xs','2xs','xs','xs']`) *"is what this section used to recommend"* and now **fails the guard** — it walks responsive arrays and attributes every element to the same prop, so all four elements fail.

### The acknowledged-exception vocabulary

`scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs:59`:
```js
const EXCEPTION_MARKER_RE = /provisional|pending|placeholder|audit-allow/i;
```

A raw literal is downgraded from failure to acknowledged exception when its **contiguous comment block** (walked back to the nearest blank line, per `466e62b`'s recalibration) contains one of those four words. This deliberately reuses the codebase's existing explanatory comments rather than maintaining a second allow-list. `zimmSubscribeSection.css.ts:1-12` is the reference:

```ts
// 45px — the height ZimmInputAction currently renders… PROVISIONAL:
// Figma's success state keeps a Textfield instance at 320x59… Pending Kiera. rem, not px…
const SIZE_SUBSCRIBE_SLOT = '2.8125rem';
```

### Testing (`testing.md`, rewritten by `542ac65`)

The key clarification: *don't duplicate coverage* does **not** license skipping a component's own test file. Resolve the tension by **scoping what it asserts** — mock the hook/child proven elsewhere, test only this component's contract. `zimmSubscribeSection/index.test.tsx` is named as the reference and does exactly that: mocks `useSubscribeSection`, `ZimmSubscribeModal`, `useUiCopy`, and `ZimmIcon`.

**The `ZimmIcon`/Vitest gap:** `ZimmIcon` imports the base SFCC icons barrel, which has a top-level side effect (`AmexSymbol.viewBox = …`) that throws under Vitest because SVG imports resolve to raw path strings. Not fixable from a test (the transform lives in Tier 1 `vitest.config.ts`). Mandatory workaround in any test rendering an icon consumer:
```ts
vi.mock('app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmIcon', () => ({ ZimmIcon: () => null }))
```

### Two cross-cutting traps worth memorising

**The Storybook/Vitest resolver trap.** Importing an already-overridden component via the SFCC base path builds and runs correctly in the real app but **silently renders the unstyled base version in Storybook and Vitest**. The `ccExtensibility` resolver is webpack-only; `.storybook/main.js` aliases straight to `node_modules` and `vitest.config.ts` doesn't touch it. Import overridden siblings by relative path.

**Payment credentials** — never in any `console.*`, Sentry event, dataLayer push, `localStorage`, or query string. Enforced by `semgrep.yml`.

---

## 5. `overrides/app/theme/` — the registration split

### What IS registered — `overrides/app/theme/index.ts:51-62`

```ts
const overrides: ThemeOverride = {
  borderWidths,
  breakpoints,
  colors,
  fonts,
  space: spacing,
  textStyles,
  components,
  styles: { global: globalStyles },
};
```

That is the complete list: **six scales**, plus `components` and `styles.global`.

### What is deliberately NOT registered — and why it matters

`foundation/index.ts` exports ten more things that never reach the theme: `fontSizes`, `lineHeights`, `letterSpacings`, `fontWeights`, `iconSizes`, `actionSizes`, `motion`, `grid`, `focusRingOffsets`, `zimmTokens`.

`theme/index.ts:31-39` gives the reason — the Zimmermann and Chakra scales **use the same key names for different values**, and remapping would silently restyle the base retail-react-app at ~199 call sites:

```
fontSizes    Chakra md=16px xs=12px 2xs=10px 3xs=7.2px
             Zimmermann md=24px xs=16px 2xs=14px 3xs=12px  (4 collisions)
transition   Chakra duration.fast=150ms slow=300ms
             Zimmermann fast=200ms default=300ms slow=500ms
sizes        Chakra sizes.lg=32rem vs iconSizes.lg=20px
```

**The consequence is the single most expensive trap in this codebase.** Three distinct failure modes, all type-valid:

- `width: 'xl'` → resolves through `theme.sizes`, not `theme.space`. Chakra's default `sizes.xl` = 36rem. **This shipped a 576px icon and collapsed the entire footer.** The scar is preserved as a comment at `zimmContactIconRow.css.ts:11-16`.
- `fontSize: '2xs'` → reads Chakra's 10px where Zimmermann's 14px was intended. Plausible, wrong.
- `lineHeight: '2xs'`, `fontSize: 'l'` → no Chakra key; the declaration is emitted verbatim and the browser **drops it silently**.

For motion/icon/action dimensions: **import the constant from `foundation/` directly**, or use `var(--zimm-*)`.

### foundation (Tier 1) vs components (Tier 2/3)

- `theme/foundation/` — 9 files, **Tier 1, UI-designer gated**, no exceptions. The alias tier is a *reference*, not a copy: `text.default: grey[900]`, never a retyped hex. `zimmTokens.ts` is fully derived by importing from the other foundation files; the only literals left are 7 numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases with nothing to derive from.
- `theme/components/` — now holds only **6 files**: `header.ts`, `listMenu.ts`, `navConstants.ts` (still Tier 2, designer-gated), `footerShared.ts` (cross-file shared values), `index.ts` (the registry), `recipeGuards.test.ts`. Everything else moved to co-location.
- `theme/globalStyles.ts` — Tier 2, the `.zimm-*` registry. **Adoption is near zero** — one Storybook demo is its only consumer.

### One canonical styling surface per component

`zimmButton.css.ts` is the sole source of truth for buttons; `globalStyles.ts` has **no** `.zimm-btn-*` classes — they were deleted because a static class can't express `_hover`/`_active`/`_disabled`/`_focusVisible`. Use Chakra's `<Button>`, never a class.

---

## 6. `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs` and `.claude/registry/`

**What it is:** five generated Markdown tables (`components.md` 88 rows, `hooks.md` 64, `utils.md` 32, `pages.md` 18, `routes.md` 18) inventorying both the Zimmermann overrides *and* the inherited `@salesforce/retail-react-app@10.0.0` base, merged, with an `Origin` column (`Base`/`Override`/`Custom`).

**Who consumes it: Claude, not humans and not CI.** Script header, `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs:1-16`:
> *"writes structured markdown tables that Claude Code reads instead of grepping the codebase."*

`.claude/skills/feature-spec/SKILL.md:37-41` uses it as the cheap substitute for a `find`+`grep` sweep; `generate-changelog/SKILL.md:49-53` diffs its git history to detect new components. `coderabbit.yaml:57-58` excludes it from AI review as build output.

**How it's generated:** **hand-rolled regex over raw file text** — no AST, no TypeScript compiler API. Zero parsing dependencies. Plus `grep`/`git log` subprocesses for the Consumers and Last-touched columns. Two gitignored caches: `.baseCache.json` (whole base-template scan, invalidated by package version + schema number) and `.overrideCache.json` (consumers count only, keyed by content sha1). Both added by Tim in `42e32dc` to stop ~150 subprocess calls per commit.

**Freshness: local only, never blocking.** `scripts/hooks/pre-commit:44-62` regenerates and `git add`s — it never fails the commit. There is **no CI drift gate and no `--check` mode**. `--no-verify`, a web-UI commit, or missing `node` leaves it silently stale.

### The conventions the registry silently enforces

Because it's regex-driven, deviation produces *no warning* — the component just doesn't appear, or appears wrong:

- **Must be `index.tsx`/`index.jsx` in its own folder.** `components/foo/foo.tsx` is invisible. `.ts` is not scanned.
- **The row name comes from the folder, not the export.** `zimmButton/` → `ZimmButton`.
- **The props type must be named exactly `<PascalFolderName>Props` and live in the same file.** When the name isn't found, it falls back to merging *every* `*Props` block in the file — which is how `SubscribeModalProps`/`BottomBarProps` once leaked into the Footer row.
- **The opening `{` must be on the same line as the type name; the closing `}` must be at column 0; fields need ≥2 leading spaces, one per line.**
- **JSDoc the exported component itself**, not a helper above it — the description resolver requires the JSDoc's following declaration to be named the row's subject.

### Two registry bugs worth knowing (both Marcel, 2026-08-22)

`13add6e` — a union-alias props type (`ZimmButtonProps = ZimmLabelButtonProps | ZimmIconButtonProps`) has no `{`, so it never matched, and the merge-everything fallback published `label: string` alongside a required `icon` — a combination the type forbids.

`ec9d161` — fixed two defects in that fix. (a) A partial union was published as complete, and because `members.length` shrank, *every surviving prop was published as required*. Now all-or-nothing (`:496-500`). (b) Requiredness depended on operand order — reversing them turned `variant?: 'primary'|'secondary'` into `variant: 'icon'`. Now presence and optionality are separated and types are unioned across members.

### Registry gaps found

1. **No CI drift gate**, no `--check` mode.
2. **`.tsx` utilities are unreachable** — `overrides/app/utils/richText.tsx` (staged today) can never appear in `utils.md`.
3. **`components.md`'s "move props to `types.ts`" guidance silently blanks the Props column** — the extractor only reads one file.
4. **Tier/Squad lists are a hand-maintained duplicate** of `frozenFiles.md`/`protectedFiles.md` with no sync test, and know only base kebab-case paths. **Everything under `ui-kits/` classifies as `4 — Feature-local`/`Shared`** regardless of reality.
5. **The registry is undocumented in `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/rules/`, and `.docs/`.** Its only documentation is the script header and two skills.

## 7. `recipeGuards.test.ts` — the real build gate

**Path:** `overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts` (365 lines). **Runs on every `npm run test`** → Vitest → the `unit-tests` job in `.github/workflows/qa.yml:207-227`, on every PR to `develop` and `release/**`.

**Scope, stated at `:36-43`:** it walks *the registered recipe map only* — `components` from `./index` plus the composed `theme`. It cannot see the same mistake as a JSX prop.

**How it walks:** `collect()` (`:263-284`) iterates `Object.entries(components)`, resolves each `baseStyle` across **all 2^5 = 32 boolean prop combinations** (`PROP_COMBINATIONS`, `:236-243`), plus `variants` and `sizes`, recursing through media queries, pseudo-selectors and responsive containers. `isResponsiveContainer` (`:181-182`) tests *"are ALL the keys breakpoints?"* — load-bearing, because `xl`/`2xl` are keys in both `breakpoints` and `spacing`.

### The six tests — precisely what fails

| Test | Fails when | Real consequence |
|---|---|---|
| `collect() actually walks the registered recipes` (`:287`) | `components` is empty or `collect()` returns nothing | **Vacuity guard.** Every other test asserts an empty array, which an empty input satisfies. Without this, deleting `components` turns the file green. |
| `no sizing property uses a bare spacing-scale key` (`:295`) | a `SIZING_PROPS` member (`width`,`height`,`boxSize`,`minW`…13 total) has a value that is a key of `spacing` | `width:'xl'` → `theme.sizes.xl` = 36rem. Shipped a 576px icon. |
| `no typography property uses a bare scale key` (`:305`) | `fontSize`/`lineHeight`/`letterSpacing` carries its own scale key **or** any spacing key | `fontSize:'2xs'` → 10px not 14px; `lineHeight:'2xs'` → declaration dropped. |
| `no compound shorthand contains a bare scale key` (`:315`) | a `padding`/`margin`/`gap`/`inset`/`p`/`m` value contains whitespace and any whitespace-separated part is a spacing key (with `var(...)` masked to `VAR` first) | `padding:'xs 0'` is emitted verbatim; the browser drops it entirely. |
| `no override-component style uses a bare token key on a registered scale` (`:331`) | a `SPACE_PROPS` member has a `spacing` key **or** a `COLOR_PROPS` member has a flattened `colors` path | **House style, not a bug** — both resolve correctly. Added by `9d5f89c`. `gap:'xs'` and `color:'text.inverse'` both fail. |
| `no recipe silently inherits a base SFCC recipe of the same name` (`:347`) | any registered recipe outside `['Button','Header','ListMenu']` has a post-composition `baseStyle` key it never declared | `extendTheme` **deep merges** — a recipe named `Footer` inherits SFCC's `Footer`. Hence `ZimmFooter`, not `Footer`. |

**The known, live blind spot.** `:38` names an instance the suite cannot reach: `overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx` has `fontSize="l"` as a JSX prop, which emits nothing. **I confirmed it is still there** — now at **line 311**, not the 302 the docstring cites (the reference has drifted 9 lines). The suggested fix is a static rule over JSX attributes in `.coderabbit/ast-grep-rules/`. **That has not been built** — the directory holds only three a11y rules (`img-missing-alt.yml`, `icon-button-missing-aria-label.yml`, `clickable-non-interactive-element.yml`) and nothing touching tokens.

**Second gate landing on the current branch (staged, not on develop):** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts` — asserts a multipart recipe's declared `parts` covers every part the component actually reads off `useMultiStyleConfig`. It walks the *component source*, deliberately, because comparing `parts` against the recipe's own `baseStyle` keys wouldn't catch a rename done consistently in both places.

**Related gate:** `overrides/app/theme/index.test.tsx` has a `scale token collisions — Chakra keeps its own meanings` block (`:111-131`) asserting `fontSizes`, `transition` and `sizes` are *not* remapped. Treat a failure there as real drift, not test noise.

# Addendum — documentation vs. code drift (delegated sweep)

Working-tree health, verified by running the gates: `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0; `npm run test` passes (22 files / 354 tests); **`npm run audit:tokens` reports 19 unacknowledged violations — the 14 pre-existing ones `overrideStyling.md` documents, plus 5 new ones in your staged `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx`.** That is the one item here that blocks nothing mechanically but will land in PR review.

## Playbook-relevant additions

### The styling hierarchy never reaches your other AI tools

`conventions.md:6-8` claims *"Update the relevant file once — both skills, and (via `scripts/syncCursorRules.mjs`) all other AI tool configs, pick it up."* The manifest in `scripts/syncCursorRules.mjs` syncs only `frozenFiles.md`, `protectedFiles.md`, `conventions.md`, `squadA.md`, `squadB.md`, `testing.md`. It does **not** sync `css.md`, `components.md`, `typescript.md`, `overrideStyling.md`, `tagging.md` — three of which sit in `conventions.md`'s own "See also" list.

Compounding it: **`AGENTS.md` never references `overrideStyling.md` at all** (`grep -c` → 0), nor `protectedFiles.md`, `tagging.md`, `squadA.md`, `squadB.md`. The largest rules file (18.8 kB), holding the entire `var(--zimm-*)` hierarchy Tim established, is orphaned from the entry-point doc *and* invisible to Cursor/Copilot. If you work in anything but Claude Code, the rules that govern UI styling are not loaded.

### `overrides.md` — the most load-bearing broken link in the rules set

`overrideStyling.md:4, :112, :179` reference `[overrides.md](./overrides.md)` three times, and the file's opening sentence positions it as the companion doc defining module-replacement correctness. **It does not exist on this branch** — only on the two unmerged spike branches, same as `product-tile/` and `link/`. So §C3 of my earlier report generalises: an entire cross-referenced rules document, not just two example components, describes a state that lives only on `feature/f2r-component-registry` / `feature/pdp-token-class-spike`.

### The `--zimm-scale-NNN` count: code comment vs rules doc

`overrides/app/theme/index.ts:47` (Tier 1) states the 15 numeric aliases *"are duplicates of the named scale"*. `overrideStyling.md:83-85` says 7 of them have **no** named-scale equivalent. **The rules doc is right** — `025` (1px), `700` (28px), `1100` (44px), `1200` (48px), `1300` (52px), `3500` (140px), `4500` (180px) are hardcoded literals in `zimmTokens.ts`; the other 8 derive from `spacing`. A Tier 1 file's own comment is the wrong one.

### `Tier 1` enforcement is narrower than `AGENTS.md` claims

`AGENTS.md:52` asserts *"CODEOWNERS routes every Tier 1 path to `@ZimmermannAU/tier-1-approvers`."* **`babel.config.js` and `tsconfig.json`** — declared Tier 1 under "Build Pipeline" in `frozenFiles.md` — are in **neither** `CODEOWNERS` **nor** `protected-file-guard.yml`'s `tier1` filter, and `CODEOWNERS` has no catch-all line. These are exactly the two files `frozenFiles.md:91` says "silently breaks every `app/` and `~` import" if wrong.

Also Tier 1 but absent from the guard workflow (CODEOWNERS does cover them): `overrides/app/ssr/`, `overrides/app/config/countries.ts`, `overrides/app/config/contentful.ts`, `vitest.setup.ts`, `.browserstack.yml`. The guard's `overrides/app/ssr.*` glob matches `ssr.js` only, not the 6-module `ssr/` directory.

### The `ui-kits` split, restated at rules-set level

The sweep confirms and sharpens my §3 gap: `components.md` and `conventions.md` contain **zero** occurrences of `ui-kits`, `atoms`, `molecules`, or `organisms`; `new-component/SKILL.md:29` still scaffolds to the flat path; `overrideStyling.md` (newest file) references `ui-kits` four times. **The rules set is internally split on its own component convention.** And `.docs/architecture.md` contradicts *itself* — `:136` correctly cites `ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton/zimmButton.css.ts` while `:130`/`:139` prescribe the never-existent `components/custom/`.

### Squad ownership is worse than I reported

Beyond the product-detail conflict: of squadA.md's 18 territory paths, only 4 exist. **Zero of squadB.md's 9 exist.** Both files' "Good vs Bad Prompts" sections instruct edits to files that aren't in the repo. Both last committed 2026-07-14 — six weeks older than every other rules file, and untouched through Tim's entire rewrite.

## Two memory files that would actively mislead you on this branch

**`sprintScope.md` — highest risk.** Last commit 2026-06-25, **two months untouched**, and `AGENTS.md` Hard Rule 14 makes it load-bearing for scoping every task. It says `:19` *"Sprint 0 — Foundation (in progress)"* while its own table `:77` puts today in Sprint 5. It places PDP in Sprints 2–3 (13 Jul – 7 Aug). **Applied literally, it would classify your current SFCC-89 PDP branch as past-sprint work** and trigger Hard Rule 14's stop-and-ask. Relatedly, `deploy-dev.yml`'s `tag-sprint` job reads `scripts/sprint.txt`, which does not exist — it has never fired.

**`projectState.md`** — `:52-63` still lists SFCC-55 as "In Progress: PR #59", but that PR **merged** 2026-08-24 and is the head of develop. `:72` lists PDP under "What's Pending" with no PDP entry anywhere. `:87` says tag-based promotion is "not yet started" — it shipped 2026-08-06/07. `:8` says "No production build has started beyond scaffolding" against 187 tracked files under `overrides/app`.

## `.docs/architecture.md` — larger stale set than I found

Confirmed wrong: React Router listed as v6 (actually **5.3.4** — `footer/index.tsx:7` uses `useHistory`); Storybook 8 (actually **^10.4.6**); axe-core "via `vitest-axe`/`axe-playwright`" (**neither installed**, zero axe test code — the only real a11y gate is `.storybook/preview.tsx:42-44`); Playwright "not yet configured" (7 projects, running in two workflows); "all services mocked (MSW stubs)" locally (**zero MSW references**, contradicting `AGENTS.md`'s own no-mocking rule); bundle ceilings `vendor.js` 250 kB / `main.css` 50 kB (actual: 550 kB, and **no CSS budget exists** — matches your prior finding); six-tier topology **omitting the Test tier**; MRT targets missing `test`/`staging`; `:193`'s claim that content types map 1:1 to `components/contentful/` components (**zero overlap**).

## Two smaller live rule violations

- **`overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx:60`** imports from `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/icons` — explicitly forbidden by `AGENTS.md` > Rules > Icons.
- **Story coverage gaps** against `components.md`: no stories for `header/`, `pageContainer/`, `uiCopyProvider/`, `product-view/`, `_app-config/` — and **no page has a story at all**, despite "Pages get a story showing the full assembly."
- `package.json:57`'s `test:lighthouse` script points at `tests/lighthouserc.js`; the real file is `lighthouserc.js` and **there is no `tests/` directory** — the script is broken. CI is unaffected (`digital-sit.yml` runs bare `lhci autorun`, which auto-discovers). `AGENTS.md:37` Hard Rule 8 names the same dead path.

## Verified clean — worth knowing so you don't re-audit

`.claude/rules/tagging.md` is entirely accurate. So are `testing.md`'s reference test files, `components.md`'s `IntlProvider`/ESLint claims, `overrideStyling.md`'s `zimmButton` constants and "14 pre-existing violations" figure, `recipeGuards.test.ts`'s six named guards and SCOPE note, `frozenFiles.md`'s v10/font/`ssr/` sections, and `.claude/registry/` itself (auto-generated, zero stale paths).

## Not determinable

Per-tier SFCC realms, Contentful environments, MuleSoft connections, and canary gating in `architecture.md` — external systems with no repo evidence. Whether `vars.RETAIL_APP_HOME` points at Dev or SIT — a repo-level GitHub variable, unresolvable locally.

---

**Net effect on the playbook:** the conventions Tim established are sound, mechanically guarded, and readable from the code. The *documentation layer around them* is the weak part — `overrideStyling.md` is authoritative but orphaned and unsynced; the tier files and squad files are largely forward-looking fiction presented as fact; and the two memory files that `AGENTS.md` makes load-bearing for scoping are stale enough to misclassify the branch you're on right now. **Trust the code, `CODEOWNERS`, `recipeGuards.test.ts`, and `tagging.md`. Verify everything else before citing it.**
